key_idea: Fan-triangulate the convex polygon from the door vertex; the prefix of triangle areas is monotone, so find the triangle where it crosses half and interpolate linearly along that edge.
sketch: Compute doubled triangle areas cross(p_i-p_0, p_{i+1}-p_0) in 64-bit integers (total at most ~1.6e15, fits). Walk i until 2*(pre+tr_i) >= S, then the point is p_i + f*(p_{i+1}-p_i) with f = (S-2*pre)/(2*tr_i), because area of the sub-triangle is linear in f. O(n). Pitfalls: keep sums exact in integers and only divide at the end; print enough digits.
